sermon.title: Christians Are From Christ - September 8, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer), likely Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Christ left us an example. He is God, kept the commandments, worked as a carpenter, assembled weekly, honored His parents, and always pleased the Father. Whoever abides in Him does not keep sinning; faith comes by hearing and has works behind it.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message comes first; the worship set follows (~53:33). He paraphrases Proverbs 29:18 as “without a progressive vision we dwell carelessly”; left as said. Includes communion.

faqs.question: What shirt did he wear?
faqs.answer: Jesus on the front, God on the back, because Jesus is the reason.

faqs.question: Why is it hard for the rich?
faqs.answer: They feel in control and don’t need God.

faqs.question: What is the side effect of obeying?
faqs.answer: God will beat the enemy in your life.

faqs.question: Did Jesus sit and order food?
faqs.answer: No; he jokes Jesus didn’t say, Father, send down the burgers.

faqs.question: What should young people do?
faqs.answer: Set a goal, learn a job skill that pays good, and pursue it.

faqs.question: Must you do chores?
faqs.answer: Yes, simple things; not if parents ask you to sell drugs.

faqs.question: Are you righteous by a sticker?
faqs.answer: No; you’re not righteous because of a label.
